blockers.note: The domestic final stroke starts just under upper bar 6. Tomoe starts low near the central crossing, so the original missing upper descending segment remains.
Tomoe's central bent stroke ends downward with no leftward terminal hook, unlike the domestic curved hook.

entries.release: Complete licensed 12-stroke geometry with domestic final-stroke upper start, curved central bend and leftward hook.

blockers.note: Tomoe retains a detached down-right dot. Domestic stroke 1 is vertical and joins horizontal 2; the previously held direction/junction mismatch remains.
Tomoe also lacks the domestic terminal turn on the outer lower hook and the upward end of the inner lower bent stroke.

entries.release: Full 13-stroke paths with domestic vertical first-stroke junction and lower hook endings. A permutation or uniform scale cannot repair those paths.

blockers.note: Domestic stroke 9 is right then straight down. Tomoe still zigzags down-left/down-right/down-left, so the old fundamental difference remains.
The final lower contour remains attached to a zigzag foot instead of the domestic straight vertical foot. Reordering does not reconcile the contour.

entries.release: Licensed 10-stroke geometry with the domestic straight bent stroke 9 and corresponding final sweep.
